newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bel-20 slips below 2,600, recovery not far.
newsitem.headline: Bel-20 slips below 2,600, recovery not far.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Bel-20 share index ends down 0.84 percent at 2,599 points after a session of profit-taking after Monday's record close, worsened by a weakened dollar, a wavering Wall Street and sagging bonds.

* Leading loser Bel-20 heavyweight UCB which saw profit-taking, outright selling before Wednesday's release of H1 results which are forecast to show 30-35 pct increase, in line with company expectations.
* Union Miniere another large loser after zinc price collapse from recent, overblown levels and dollar slippage below 1.83 marks.

* Some dealers said it would not be long before today's sellers returned to the market. They said funds and institutionals were still liquid and looking for ways to boost low yields on their bond portfolios. Low inflation and interest rates meant the fundamentals were still good for shares.

* More sceptical traders said the market would first want to have confirmation of H1 earnings expectations before re-affirming current P/Es. They also cited talk of central bank action to curb the dollar and to keep costly imports from boosting domestic inflation.
